maddeler.e:
نصد (form I)
# نَصُدُّ (naṣuddu) /na.sˤud.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of صَدَّ (ṣadda)
# نُصَدُّ (nuṣaddu) /nu.sˤad.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of صَدَّ (ṣadda)
# نَصُدَّ (naṣudda) /na.sˤud.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of صَدَّ (ṣadda)
# نُصَدَّ (nuṣadda) /nu.sˤad.da/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive/
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
